	definition:
		cashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		newCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->includes(cashDesk)
	precondition:
		cashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newCashDesk: CashDesk in
		newCashDesk.oclIsNew() and
		result = newCashDesk
}
